report_name: Austrian Foreign Ministry Hacked, Staff Contact Info Leaked

threat_actors.name: Russia
threat_actors.description: Nation-state actor suggested as a possible, though unconfirmed, perpetrator of the cyberattack against the Austrian Foreign Ministry, given the geopolitical context and a history of previous cyberattacks attributed to Russia.
threat_actors.goals: Intelligence gathering on diplomatic personnel for future targeting.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers compromised the Austrian Foreign Ministry's public-facing website, which was managed by an external service provider. The article suggests the attack vector was likely a vulnerability in the website's Content Management System (CMS) or custom code, with SQL Injection mentioned as a possible technique.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Local System
attack_patterns.description: Attackers accessed and viewed data records from a database on the compromised web server, exposing the names and professional work contact details of ministry employees.

identities.name: Austrian Foreign Ministry
identities.description: The victim of a cyberattack where employee contact data was exposed from its public-facing website between November 12 and 13, 2026.

indicators.name: Potential SQL Injection Attempt in URI
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential SQL Injection Attempt in URI
id: e1a2b3c4-d5e6-4f7a-8b9c-0d1e2f3a4b5c
status: experimental
description: Detects common SQL injection keywords and patterns in the URI query string of web server logs, as suggested by the analysis of the Austrian Foreign Ministry breach.
references:
  - https://securityaffairs.com/203680/hacking/cyberattack-on-austrian-foreign-ministry-exposes-diplomatic-staff-data.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-22
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-query|contains:
      - '1=1'
      - 'select '
      - 'union '
      - ' from '
      - ' where '
      - ' and 1='
      - ' or 1='
      - 'information_schema'
      - 'sysobjects'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects common SQL injection keywords in URI queries, which could indicate an attempt to exploit a public-facing application like the one that affected the Austrian Foreign Ministry.

indicators.name: Anomalous Data Egress from Web Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Anomalous Data Egress from Web Server
id: a2b3c4d5-e6f7-4a8b-9c0d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
status: experimental
description: Detects potentially anomalous large data transfers from a web server, which could indicate data exfiltration following a breach, similar to the data exposure at the Austrian Foreign Ministry.
references:
  - https://securityaffairs.com/203680/hacking/cyberattack-on-austrian-foreign-ministry-exposes-diplomatic-staff-data.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-22
tags:
  - attack.t1005
  - attack.collection
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    sc-bytes|gt: 10000000
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects potentially anomalous large data transfers from a web server, which could indicate data exfiltration following a breach.
